verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents itself as 100% open-source and deployable on-premise. It ships a Kubernetes/Helm self-hosting path, including a zero-config Minikube development chart, and a community user reports deploying the open-source version easily. missing for 10: a documented feature-complete deployment path without Kubernetes, since functions, profile builders and connector syncs require a cluster.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Jitsu is 100% open-source and can be deployed to any on-premise infrastructure.
Run Jitsu yourself on Kubernetes with Helm, fully under your control.
A feature-complete Jitsu deployment requires a Kubernetes cluster
Development Helm chart: deploy the full architecture to Minikube with zero configuration.
It was very easy and straightforward to get started, deploy and start collecting things (into BigQuery).
